name: Alterdiv Sales Display for WooCommerce
author: Rasel

sections.description:
Alterdiv Sales Display for WooCommerce is a lightweight WooCommerce plugin that allows you to display the total number of sales for a product directly on your store pages.

The plugin is designed to be simple, flexible, and fully customizable. You can control where the sales counter appears and style it using various design options.

Key features include displaying the sales counter on single product pages, shop pages, and via shortcode. The plugin also includes styling options such as font size, color, padding, borders, and more.

This plugin is fully translation-ready and follows WordPress coding standards.

Features

  • Display WooCommerce product total sales
  • Show sales counter on single product page
  • Optional display on shop/archive pages
  • Shortcode support
  • Custom prefix and suffix text
  • Option to hide or show products with zero sales
  • Customizable display position
  • Styling controls (font size, colors, padding, borders)
  • Translation-ready (.pot file included)
  • Lightweight and optimized
sections.installation:
1. Upload the alterdiv-sales-display-for-woocommerce plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Sales Display to configure the plugin settings.
  4. Adjust the display and styling options as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Alterdiv Sales Display for WooCommerce works only if WooCommerce is installed and active.

Can I display the sales counter using a shortcode?

Yes. Use the following shortcode:

[adivsdfw_sales_display]

Can I customize the appearance of the sales counter?

Yes. The plugin provides styling controls including font size, color, padding, border settings, and more.
